title: Improve Low-Level Code Calculator performance
summary: Low-Level Code Calculator performance improved by filtering out items without a Production BOM and replacing a List with a Dictionary for node key tracking, reducing calculation time significantly in real-world scenarios.
key_points: Production BOM query now filters for non-empty BOM numbers before opening
NodeKeysAddedToTree changed from List to Dictionary to improve lookup and insert performance from O(n) to near-constant
Eliminates unnecessary cache invalidation and item loading for items without Production BOMs
New extensibility point OnBeforeItemProductionBOMsOpen added to allow query customization
Combined changes reduced calculation time from 10 hours to 2 hours in tested scenario
quote: the combination of these changes reduced low-level code calculation time from roughly 10 hours to about 2 hours
